headline: We built a printing press and forgot to put an address on the envelopes.
read: Month 1 is over and the verdict is clean: production works, conversion doesn't. The machine shipped 39 reels, 29 Shorts, 128 articles and ~1,250 social posts into 44,890 reach — and came back with 9 Facebook followers, 8 lifetime engagement actions, 0 YouTube subs, 0 Instagram followers, and 7 email subs that haven't moved since July 13th. The one number that IS growing is total audience: 32 → 69 in two weeks, all of it on the small channels (Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Threads) where we actually reply to people. That's the tell. Reach isn't the constraint. Being asked for something is. Two hard findings this week. First, the $7/day ad campaign is PAUSED — 16,704 video views and a warm retarget pool sitting idle, exactly the pool the last two reviews said to convert. Second, and worse: /share-your-story/ has been POSTing into a 404 since launch. Every contractor who filled out that form was silently dropped, which is why the phase-2 EEAT plan has produced zero real quotes for a month — it wasn't apathy, it was a missing endpoint. Fixed today.
next_move: Stop adding volume; add asks. (1) The retarget→Page-Like campaign against the 25/50/95% video-watchers is still the cheapest follower we will ever buy, and it's been recommended and unbuilt for three weeks — it needs Aaron to resume spend (stays at $7/day, guardrail is $10). Until then, ad video views are frozen and that goal is capped. (2) The email list is the only owned asset and it's flat at 7: the capture block sits at the BOTTOM of every article, after the FAQ. Move it mid-article and give it a real deliverable (the refund-filing checklist from today's post is the obvious first magnet). (3) FB's 2026 rules now weight creator-origin verification and a viewer 'true interest' rating — synthetic TTS reels are exactly what that demotes. Reel queue was reweighted today toward money/pricing/proof scripts (the only archetypes that scored in July; pure gag reels scored 0), but the real unlock is a phone camera on a real jobsite. (4) AEO research says fact density lifts low-ranked pages up to 40% in AI answers — our template already does this, so the next SEO move is retrofitting the older thin posts rather than writing more of them. (5) Website traffic has read 0 every single day since launch: CF analytics was never wired, so we are flying blind on whether 128 articles do anything. Wire it before Month 2 is judged. Goals recalibrated off real 14-day pace — the dashboard now tells the truth instead of showing 1%.
